info.title: Да забей — internal API
info.description: Versioned internal API. Errors use RFC 9457 problem+json with a stable `code`. See docs/API.md.

get.summary: Football manager: the open lots of my league
get.description: Lots come to a deal once a day at the 10:00 Moscow tick: the highest bid wins (equal bids: the earliest). The least next bid is the start price, then the best bid plus the step (10, 20 or 30 percent).

open.description: The market is open for my club (10 played matches).

mine.description: My club put the player up.

nominal.description: The nominal value of the player.

stepPercent.description: 10, 20 or 30: how much more than the best bid the next one must be.

minBid.description: The least a new bid can be.

leading.description: My club has the best bid.

myBid.description: The highest bid of my club on the lot.

endsAt.description: The moment of the daily tick (10:00 Moscow time) that settles the lot, ISO 8601.

lots.description: The open lots of my league, the nearest tick first.

post.summary: Football manager: put a player of my club up for sale
post.description: The start price is from half to twice the nominal value (422 manager.price_invalid), the step 10, 20 or 30 percent (422 manager.step_invalid). The lot is settled at the first 10:00 Moscow tick at least 12 hours ahead. 409: manager.market_closed (before 10 played matches), manager.player_unavailable, manager.player_locked (the week after a purchase), manager.contract_ending (under half a season of contract left, or retiring), manager.squad_min (17 players stay), manager.lots_limit (5 open lots).

price.description: From half to twice the nominal value of the player.

post.summary: Football manager: bid on a lot
post.description: No money is held: the winner pays when the lot is settled; a bid that cannot be paid then (no money, no room in the squad, a deal with the seller already made this season) is struck out and the next best is tried. 409: manager.bid_too_low, manager.own_auction, manager.bid_leading, manager.auction_closed, manager.no_money (budget below the bid or negative), manager.deal_limit, manager.market_closed.

post.summary: Football manager: take my lot off the market
post.description: Only the seller, and only while nobody has bid (409 manager.has_bids).

get.summary: Football manager: the contracts of my squad
get.description: For each player: the wage of a round (fixed at signing), the last season of the contract, the rounds left, whether he can be put up (and why not) or offered a new contract, and what breaking the contract costs now.

wage.description: The wage of a round, fixed when the contract was signed.

contractUntil.description: The last season the contract covers.

roundsLeft.description: The rounds of the league left on the contract.

tradableAfter.description: A bought or exchanged player cannot be put up before this moment.

canExtend.description: An offer is allowed: from half a season to 2 seasons left, one offer a season.

breakPenalty.description: What breaking the contract costs now.

post.summary: Football manager: offer a player a new contract
post.description: Allowed with from half a season to 2 seasons left, one offer a season for a player (409 manager.offer_used; 422 manager.contract_invalid). The player may refuse (about 10% with good morale, 40% with middling, 70% with poor): then the old contract goes on. The new term (1 to 3 seasons) starts from the end of the old one, with the wage of today.

post.summary: Football manager: break a contract
post.description: The club pays two thirds of the wages of the rounds left; the player goes to the pool of free players of the league. 409 manager.squad_min (17 stay), manager.no_money, manager.player_unavailable.

get.summary: Football manager: exchange offers of my club
get.description: Pending offers first (to my club and from it), then the last resolved ones; and the other clubs of my league run by people. An offer lives 48 hours.

locked.description: Cannot be exchanged now: the week after a purchase, an ending contract, a lot.

clubs.description: The other clubs of my league run by people.

incoming.description: The offer is to my club (it can accept or decline).

locked.description: Cannot be exchanged now: the week after a purchase, an ending contract, a lot.
Cannot be exchanged now: the week after a purchase, an ending contract, a lot.

cash.description: Positive: the proposer pays on top. Negative: he gets it.

trades.description: Pending offers first, then the last resolved ones.

post.summary: Football manager: offer an exchange of players
post.description: 1 to 3 players for 1 to 3 players of another club of my league, with money on top if wanted (positive: I pay; negative: I get it; at most twice the value of what the payer receives; the one who gets it pays a 10% tax). The other club accepts or declines; the offer lives 48 hours. Both squads must have 17 to 23 players after it, one deal with one club a season, exchanged players cannot be resold for a week.

cash.description: Positive: I pay on top. Negative: I get it. At most twice the value of what the payer receives.

get.summary: Football manager: the squad of another club of my league
get.description: What can be asked for in an exchange; locked players cannot be exchanged now.

locked.description: Cannot be exchanged now: the week after a purchase, an ending contract, a lot.

post.summary: Football manager: accept an exchange offer
post.description: Everything is checked again; the players and the money change hands in one transaction. 409 manager.trade_closed for an offer that is not open any more.

put.summary: Save the caller's predictions for matches of one tour
put.description: New predictions are inserted, existing ones changed. Allowed while the season is active, the match is not played or cancelled and the tour deadline has not passed (the database enforces it): otherwise 409 predictions.closed. A match outside the tour is 422. Scores are whole numbers 0–99.

post.summary: Start signing in through the Telegram bot
post.description: Creates a one-time attempt (valid 10 minutes). The visitor opens the bot link, presses Start and picks the two-digit `code` in the bot; poll `/auth/telegram/status` until it says `confirmed`, then go to `/auth/telegram?token=…`.

token.description: Secret of this sign-in attempt; keep it in the browser, never log it.

code.description: Two-digit number to show; the visitor picks it in the bot.

appUrl.description: tg:// link that opens the bot in the Telegram app.

webUrl.description: https://t.me link for devices without the app.

post.summary: Sign in from inside the Telegram Mini App
post.description: The site opened as a Mini App sends the signed launch data it got from Telegram. The signature is checked with the bot token and the launch must be less than an hour old; then the session cookie is set for that Telegram user (an account is created on the first visit). No number to pick: Telegram has already shown who the visitor is.

initData.description: The signed launch data of the Mini App (`Telegram.WebApp.initData`), unchanged.

signedIn.description: The session cookie is set; reload the page.

get.summary: Progress of a Telegram sign-in attempt

status.description: confirmed: continue to /auth/telegram?token=… to open the session.

get.summary: Latest regular videos of the YouTube channel (no Shorts), newest first
get.description: Read from the channel's RSS and cached for an hour. If YouTube fails, the last cached list is returned; without one the endpoint answers 503 videos.unavailable.

get.summary: The common chat: messages of the last 3 days
get.description: Signed-in users only. Messages older than 3 days are not returned and are deleted for good (D-098). Live updates come through Supabase Realtime; this endpoint is the first load and the fallback.

avatarPath.description: Storage path of the author's photo, if any.

banned.description: True if an admin has shut the caller out of the chat.

post.summary: Write to the common chat
post.description: 1–500 characters. One message per 2 seconds per user (429 api.too_many_requests). A user an admin has shut out gets 403 chat.banned; a user without a nickname gets 409 chat.no_nickname.

avatarPath.description: Storage path of the author's photo, if any.

delete.description: The author deletes their own message; an admin deletes any. A message of someone else is 404.

put.summary: Shut a user out of the chat or let them back
put.description: Idempotent. Messages the user already wrote stay until deleted or until 3 days pass.

post.summary: Football manager: make my club
post.description: One club per user. The server generates the same starting squad for everyone (20 players, 2 GK / 7 DEF / 7 MID / 4 FWD, the same total rating) once; it cannot be generated again. 409 manager.club_exists for a second club, 409 manager.name_taken for a taken name (compared without case).

budget.description: Game dollars; negative = in debt (no purchases).

logoUrl.description: The club's own logo, if it has one.

real.description: Rating that counts in a match: overall scaled by form, fitness, morale.

league.description: Null while the club has no league yet.

get.summary: Football manager: the matches of my club
get.description: All 38 rounds of the season by round. A round is played every day at 10:00 Moscow time (07:00 UTC).

kickoffAt.description: ISO 8601, UTC. Matches are played at 10:00 Moscow time.

kind.description: A friendly does not count for the table.

matches.description: The matches of my club, by round.

get.summary: Football manager: one match with its chronicle
get.description: A match of my league. The chronicle and both lineups are empty until the match is played. A match of another league is 404.

kickoffAt.description: ISO 8601, UTC. Matches are played at 10:00 Moscow time.

kind.description: A friendly does not count for the table.

a.description: Surname of the player who gave the pass.

pid.description: Id of the player `p` (matches played after DAZBY-153).

events.description: The chronicle; empty before the match.

get.summary: Football manager: the lineup my club plays with
get.description: saved is false when the club has not chosen (or the saved lineup no longer fits the squad): the best lineup is used, without any penalty. locked is true once a round of the club is due.

saved.description: False when the club has not chosen: the best lineup is used.

locked.description: True from five minutes before the kickoff of the next match: nothing can change.

lockAt.description: The moment the lineup stops being accepted: kickoff minus 5 minutes.

put.description: 11 players of my club: one goalkeeper and the defenders, midfielders and forwards the formation needs. 409 manager.lineup_locked after the kickoff of a due round.

put.summary: Football manager: choose what the players train
put.description: For each player an attribute of his own or null (rest). A round of training costs 3 fitness; a fit player may grow by a point, never above his hidden potential, and slower with age. 409 manager.training_locked from the kickoff of a due round; 422 for a player of another club or an attribute the player does not have.

focus.description: An attribute of the player, or null to rest.

post.summary: Football manager: ask for a friendly match with a random club of my league
post.description: Only in the preseason, and the match must fall before the next season starts. The match is at the next 10:00 Moscow time, one a day for each club; it does not count for the table and changes the form, fitness and morale of the players half as much. 409 manager.friendly_unavailable outside the preseason, 409 manager.friendly_busy when no club is free that day.

get.summary: Football manager: the money of my club
get.description: The budget in game dollars (negative = in debt), what the squad is worth and costs a round, and the last 60 operations of the ledger, newest first.

squadNominal.description: The sum of the nominal values of the squad.

wagePerRound.description: What the squad costs in a round of the league.

get.summary: Football manager: the free players of my league
get.description: 30 free players a month for every league; the unsold ones are replaced next month. open is true after 10 played matches. A free player costs his nominal value, 1000 · 1.12^(rating − 60) · a factor of the age.

open.description: The market opens after 10 played matches.

price.description: The nominal value: what the club pays.

players.description: The free players of the league this month.

post.summary: Football manager: buy a free player at his nominal value
post.description: 409 manager.market_closed before 10 played matches, 409 manager.player_unavailable when the player is gone or from another league, 409 manager.squad_full with 23 players, 409 manager.no_money when the budget is below the price or negative. The price is paid out of the game (it goes to nobody).

put.summary: Football manager: set or remove the logo of my club
put.description: The logo is a picture the user uploaded to the avatars bucket (folder of the user; PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB). path null removes it. Without a logo the club is shown by its two colours.

path.description: Storage path in the avatars bucket (own folder), or null to remove the logo.
